tokenize_text_with_CLIP: tokenize a string or list of strings using the CLIP SimpleTokenizer and return a torch tensor
decode_token_ids_to_text: decode a tensor of token IDs back into human-readable text using the CLIP tokenizer
create_HFTokenizer_wrapper: create a HuggingFace tokenizer wrapper that tokenizes text with configurable context length and padding
clean_text_with_basic_clean: clean text by fixing unicode issues and unescaping HTML entities using ftfy and html
clean_whitespace_with_whitespace_clean: normalize whitespace in text by collapsing multiple spaces and stripping leading and trailing whitespace
